prompt: Using the supplied empty metric scene and neutral render rig, make a lightweight stylized non-royal quadrupedal enemy scout. Give it a clear +Y forward direction, a low alert silhouette, a visibly named SensorHead and two visibly named Propulsion modules. Use 4,000-12,000 triangles, at most five materials, deterministic names under EnemyScoutRoot, and no rig. Ground it at Z=0 with applied transforms and no negative scale. Save output/enemy-scout.blend, export output/enemy-scout.glb, and render front, side, and three-quarter views as output/enemy-front.png, output/enemy-side.png, and output/enemy-three-quarter.png. Report the work performed and relative artifact paths.
